The second round of the presidential election is scheduled to take place in Amazonas, Brazil on October 25, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the listed candidate who receives the most valid votes in the second round of this election from Amazonas.

This market will resolve to the candidate that occupies the highest finishing position after applying this ranking.

This market will resolve based on the result of the election, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the Brazilian government, specifically the Superior Electoral Court (Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, TSE) (e.g., https://dadosabertos.tse.jus.br/).
